# Soak USA ,  LLM-Friendly Site Summary

> Soak USA is a directory of hot springs, natural thermal pools, and geothermal soaking spots across the United States.

## About
- Domain: soakusa.net
- Type: Location directory
- Coverage: 359 mapped directory records across 14 US states
- Data: Records may include GPS coordinates, water-temperature notes, amenities, and access information

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://soakusa.net): Browse featured hot springs and search by state
- [Browse by State](https://soakusa.net/browse-states): Browse the current directory coverage
- [Privacy Policy](https://soakusa.net/privacy): Current privacy and tracking practices
- [About](https://soakusa.net/about): Mission and editorial standards
- [Contact](https://soakusa.net/contact): Get in touch

## Data Coverage
Directory records show only the fields present in the underlying data. These may include name, state, city, GPS coordinates, description, temperature notes, amenities, access notes, and safety information. Conditions and access must be verified with the responsible operator or land manager.

## Safety Information
This site includes safety guidance for hot spring visitors: temperature checking, hydration, health conditions, and Leave No Trace principles.
